LOKESH RANJAN Technology Project/Program Manager (VP) | Core Banking & Credit cards | 21 Years +91 8800961118| Lzranjan@hotmail.com | Lokesh Ranjan - NatWest Group | LinkedIn

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Technology Program Manager (Vice President) with 21 years of experience delivering large-scale banking and financial technology projects in Core banking and Credit card services. Currently leading Agile Release Trains for Core Banking technology Projects at NatWest Group, where I have worked for more than 15 years. Expertise in SAFe/Agile delivery, PI Planning, vendor governance, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment across Core & digital platforms. Consistent track record of driving digital transformation, regulatory compliance, and platform modernisation initiatives with measurable business outcomes.

MBA (FMS Delhi) | B. Tech – IIT-BHU | Certified Scrum Master | SAFe Agilist | PSPO I

CORE COMPETENCIES

Programme & Delivery Management: SAFe Agile, Scrum, Agile Release Trains (ART), PI Planning, SDLC, Kanban, DevOps, Release Management Banking domain: Core Banking (Mainframe, microservices), Credit Card (VisionPlus), Payments, Digital Channels, Regulatory Compliance Leadership & Governance: Stakeholder Management, Vendor & Supplier Governance, Budget Negotiation, Cross- functional Team Leadership, Risk Management, Project finance and Forecast management Tools & Platforms: Jira, Confluence, Planview, LeanKit, GitLab, Oracle Finance

CERTIFICATIONS & TRAINING

Certified Scrum Master, SAFe Agilist (Certified), Professional Scrum Product Owner I (PSPO I) • PMP preparation training, TOGAF Training • Training on Cloud & Emerging Tech: AWS Cloud, AI-ML, AI Agents (AI Engineering Agentic Track: The complete Agent & MCP Course), GitHub, IDEs (vs-code, Cursor with AI LLMs)

EDUCATION

MBA – Executive (Evening Classroom) | Faculty of Management Studies (FMS), Delhi University CGPA: 8.29 / 10 — First Class with Master Degree

2020 – 2022

B.Tech. – IIT-BHU (Indian Institute of Technology, BHU), Varanasi DGPA: 7.77 / 10 — First Class

2001 – 2005

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Vice President – Technology Program Manager VP (Dec 2021 – Present Gurugram, India), AVP (Jan 2015 – Dec 2021 Gurugram, India)

NatWest Group

Lead end-to-end delivery of technology programmes and Agile Release Trains (ARTs) for Core Banking using the SAFe Agile framework, coordinating iterative delivery across mainframe, middleware, and digital (mobile, streaming, off-host) platforms.

Oversee programme governance across global, cross-functional teams, ensuring adherence to timelines, product backlogs, budgets, and quality benchmarks. Overall team size varies between 50 to 85 team members.

Collaborate with senior business and technology stakeholders to define programme scope, manage risks, and establish measurable success metrics.

Lead vendor and supplier governance, including contract negotiations and performance management of third-party delivery teams.

Champion digital transformation and regulatory compliance initiatives for Core Banking platforms, delivering modernisation programmes with quantifiable business outcomes.

Recognised with multiple NatWest Living Our Values (LoV) awards for outstanding project delivery and collaborative leadership.

Software Designer (Senior Developer) • NatWest Group Gurugram, India

Jan 2011 – Dec 2014

Served as Software Designer in mainframe technology, Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Core Outputs and Core Back-Office platforms, providing technical leadership on key applications: Central Despatch, CODS/Faster Payments, CUSREK, BD2, IRRS, and COI (Certificates of Interest).

Team Lead • Attra InfoTech (GE Money Australia & HSBC Global Technology Centre) Pune, India

Jan 2009 – Jan 2011

Delivered Visa 9.1 compliance project for GE Money Australia ahead of deadline; team received a 5/5 client satisfaction rating and was awarded Monthly Spot Award for extraordinary performance.

Designed and implemented new CICS/COBOL/DB2 applications for account origination and account opening processes at HSBC Pune location.

Led technical design, Development and testing for HSBC Europe credit card migration to the One HSBC Card platform at HSBC Pune location.

Senior Software Engineer • Satyam Computers (Royal Bank of Scotland) Gurgaon, India

Feb 2008 – Dec 2008

Developed new switched-account functionality enabling overdraft facilities for migrated customers (NICC Remedy G project). Designed and developed applications for real-time account maintenance within back-office banking systems.

Associate Consultant • Capgemini Consulting India (HSBC Card Services) Pune, India

Jun 2005 – Feb 2008

Delivered multiple compliance and card-scheme migration projects (Visa/Mastercard, Europay-to-Mastercard IPM) for VisionPlus credit card software on Mainframe for HSBC bank.

Developed fraud-detection enhancements using the FAS-RAPTOR scoring engine, strengthening real-time transaction security. Implemented new online authorisation systems to secure CVV2/CVC2 data within the VisionPlus platform HSBC bank. Delivered clearing, settlement, and promotions functionality for the B&Q store card launch. For HSBC Europe.

KEY DELIVERABLES AT NATWEST (SELECTED)

End-to-end programme delivery highlights across Core Banking, Mobile, and Digital platforms:

2026 – Project Reach: enhanced customer communication workflows for gone-away customers. COSA (Changes of servicing accounts) in core banking for Loan products through mobile and Ebanking (digital channels)

2025 – Term Product Digitalisation: end-to-end digitalisation involving Core and Mobile platforms. • 2024 – COBOL End-of-Life (EoL) Remediation: modernisation of critical Core Banking applications. • 2023 – Savings Round-Up: new savings feature delivered across mobile channels. • 2021–2022 – HODEC Back-Office Core Simplification & Transformation programme. • 2020–2022 – HCSTC Alerts, Pricing, and Statements regulatory compliance projects. • 2019 – SAO Loan, S2C (Sceptre-to-COBOL migration), and HCSTC Prompts projects. • 2017-2018 – EDGS Core Ebanking API, EDGS Regulatory Programme • 2015–2016 – Williams & Glyn (W&G) Programme: Core Outputs and Core Back-Office workstreams. • 2012–2014 – BBA Overdraft Transparency, CODS SEPA, and Cash ISA EOY — recognised by the business for cross- team collaboration.

2010–2011 – Rainbow Segregation automated account-switching projects (AAS1 & AAS2).

Technology

Core technical skills: Mainframe Technology (COBOL, CICS, DB2, VSAM, JCL, ZOS connect, Tyk etc.), endevor

Additionally, I have done hands-on with HTML, JavaScript, ReactJs, java, AI LLMs to improve my technical skills.

PROFESSIONAL INTERESTS

Interests: Digital transformation in banking, regulatory compliance, platform modernisation, and AI-driven solutions for future-ready financial services applications.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Vice President – Technology Program Manager VP (Dec 2021 – Present Gurugram, India), AVP (Jan 2015 – Dec 2021 Gurugram, India)
NatWest Group
Lead end-to-end delivery of technology programmes and Agile Release Trains (ARTs) for Core Banking using the SAFe Agile framework, coordinating iterative delivery across mainframe, middleware, and digital (mobile, streaming, off-host) platforms.
Oversee programme governance across global, cross-functional teams, ensuring adherence to timelines, product backlogs, budgets, and quality benchmarks. Overall team size varies between 50 to 85 team members.
Collaborate with senior business and technology stakeholders to define programme scope, manage risks, and establish measurable success metrics.
Lead vendor and supplier governance, including contract negotiations and performance management of third-party delivery teams.
Champion digital transformation and regulatory compliance initiatives for Core Banking platforms, delivering modernisation programmes with quantifiable business outcomes.
Recognised with multiple NatWest Living Our Values (LoV) awards for outstanding project delivery and collaborative leadership.
Software Designer (Senior Developer) • NatWest Group Gurugram, India
Jan 2011 – Dec 2014
Served as Software Designer in mainframe technology, Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Core Outputs and Core Back-Office platforms, providing technical leadership on key applications: Central Despatch, CODS/Faster Payments, CUSREK, BD2, IRRS, and COI (Certificates of Interest).
Team Lead • Attra InfoTech (GE Money Australia & HSBC Global Technology Centre) Pune, India
Jan 2009 – Jan 2011
Delivered Visa 9.1 compliance project for GE Money Australia ahead of deadline; team received a 5/5 client satisfaction rating and was awarded Monthly Spot Award for extraordinary performance.
Designed and implemented new CICS/COBOL/DB2 applications for account origination and account opening processes at HSBC Pune location.
Led technical design, Development and testing for HSBC Europe credit card migration to the One HSBC Card platform at HSBC Pune location.
Senior Software Engineer • Satyam Computers (Royal Bank of Scotland) Gurgaon, India
Feb 2008 – Dec 2008
Developed new switched-account functionality enabling overdraft facilities for migrated customers (NICC Remedy G project). Designed and developed applications for real-time account maintenance within back-office banking systems.
Associate Consultant • Capgemini Consulting India (HSBC Card Services) Pune, India
Jun 2005 – Feb 2008
Delivered multiple compliance and card-scheme migration projects (Visa/Mastercard, Europay-to-Mastercard IPM) for VisionPlus credit card software on Mainframe for HSBC bank.
Developed fraud-detection enhancements using the FAS-RAPTOR scoring engine, strengthening real-time transaction security. Implemented new online authorisation systems to secure CVV2/CVC2 data within the VisionPlus platform HSBC bank. Delivered clearing, settlement, and promotions functionality for the B&Q store card launch. For HSBC Europe.

2026 – Project Reach: enhanced customer communication workflows for gone-away customers. COSA (Changes of servicing accounts) in core banking for Loan products through mobile and Ebanking (digital channels)
2025 – Term Product Digitalisation: end-to-end digitalisation involving Core and Mobile platforms. • 2024 – COBOL End-of-Life (EoL) Remediation: modernisation of critical Core Banking applications. • 2023 – Savings Round-Up: new savings feature delivered across mobile channels. • 2021–2022 – HODEC Back-Office Core Simplification & Transformation programme. • 2020–2022 – HCSTC Alerts, Pricing, and Statements regulatory compliance projects. • 2019 – SAO Loan, S2C (Sceptre-to-COBOL migration), and HCSTC Prompts projects. • 2017-2018 – EDGS Core Ebanking API, EDGS Regulatory Programme • 2015–2016 – Williams & Glyn (W&G) Programme: Core Outputs and Core Back-Office workstreams. • 2012–2014 – BBA Overdraft Transparency, CODS SEPA, and Cash ISA EOY — recognised by the business for cross- team collaboration.
2010–2011 – Rainbow Segregation automated account-switching projects (AAS1 & AAS2).
Technology
Core technical skills: Mainframe Technology (COBOL, CICS, DB2, VSAM, JCL, ZOS connect, Tyk etc.), endevor
Additionally, I have done hands-on with HTML, JavaScript, ReactJs, java, AI LLMs to improve my technical skills.
